fixture_set: Domic Home Passport receipt intake v1
purpose: Controlled input fixtures for real OCR upload and human-confirmation tests. These expected values are ground truth, not measured OCR results.
limitations: Six synthetic inputs do not represent real-world extraction accuracy.
English text only; no Arabic OCR quality claim is supported by this fixture set.

OCR alone may return no text for both an unreadable receipt and an unrelated landscape. In that case the UI should state that no readable receipt details were found, rather than claiming to know the photo content.
No input should create a saved history entry before explicit user confirmation.
